Waves 1 & 2 | Ballot support, comprehension and media trust
A retrospective readout of two randomized, placebo-controlled message tests on
Massachusetts Ballot Question 3, fielded with Grow Progress in October 2026.
Descriptive research findings and audience hypotheses to test — not a paid-media
selection plan.

C A R D E X A M P L E S S U P P L I E D BY T H E T E A M
T H E C A R D I T E R AT I O N
Following Wave 1’s strong support results but limited
comprehension findings, the team added explanatory on-screen
cards. Wave 2 subsequently showed detectable comprehension
gains for three videos. This is consistent with the team’s learning
objective, although the experiment tested complete videos
rather than isolating the cards.
L I M I TAT I O N
Different videos and separate samples; no cards-
versus-no-cards randomized comparison.
What was measured. Multiple-choice recognition, asked after
respondents read a written explanation of Question 3 — not unaided
Unchanged frames from Wave 2 creative. Examples only —
recall, and not long-term retention.
not proof that the cards caused the results, and not
attributed to individual videos.
Levels are rounded displayed percentages from the Grow Progress Wave 2 comprehension topline; ≈ lifts are arithmetic differences
between them. Detectable = meets the source’s 90% criterion versus placebo; inconclusive is not evidence of no effect. Wave 1 lifts are
published values versus the Wave 1 placebo.
